payload.summary: Description lists are malformed on three routes, breaking term/definition association
payload.detail: axe definition-list plus dlitem (12 nodes each on two routes). Shape is dl > div > div > dt/dd; HTML permits one wrapper, not two. colour-coding-reference-content.tsx:121-138, source-method-reference-content.tsx:89-94, service-detail-page.tsx:391. A screen reader reads paired data as plain prose. The correct single-div shape already exists at source-method-reference-content.tsx:254-262. WCAG 1.3.1.
